entities.name: L2 U2N Relay UE
entities.description: A UE configured by the network to operate as a Layer 2 User-to-Network relay. It receives relay operation configurations including parameters for connected remote UEs.

entities.name: sl-L2RelayUEConfig
entities.description: A configuration message sent by the network to configure L2 U2N Relay UE operations. It contains lists for releasing and adding/modifying remote UEs.

entities.name: sl-RemoteUE-ToReleaseList
entities.description: A list within sl-L2RelayUEConfig indicating which L2 U2N Remote UEs should be released.

entities.name: sl-RemoteUE-ToAddModList
entities.description: A list within sl-L2RelayUEConfig indicating which L2 U2N Remote UEs should be added or modified.

entities.name: L2 U2N Remote UE release
entities.description: Procedure performed by the UE when sl-RemoteUE-ToReleaseList is present in sl-L2RelayUEConfig, as specified in clause 5.3.5.15.2.

entities.name: L2 U2N Remote UE addition/modification
entities.description: Procedure performed by the UE when sl-RemoteUE-ToAddModList is present in sl-L2RelayUEConfig, as specified in clause 5.3.5.15.3.

entities.name: sl-RemoteUE-ToReleaseList present
entities.description: Condition where the sl-L2RelayUEConfig contains the sl-RemoteUE-ToReleaseList IE.

entities.name: sl-RemoteUE-ToAddModList present
entities.description: Condition where the sl-L2RelayUEConfig contains the sl-RemoteUE-ToAddModList IE.

relations.description: The sl-L2RelayUEConfig may contain the sl-RemoteUE-ToReleaseList information element.
The sl-L2RelayUEConfig may contain the sl-RemoteUE-ToAddModList information element.
If the condition that sl-RemoteUE-ToReleaseList is present is met, the UE performs the L2 U2N Remote UE release procedure.
If the condition that sl-RemoteUE-ToAddModList is present is met, the UE performs the L2 U2N Remote UE addition/modification procedure.
The L2 U2N Relay UE is configured by the network using the sl-L2RelayUEConfig information element.
